generator: Python random.Random with SHA256-derived integer seed; weighted exponential keys log(U)/weight; within-portfolio deduplication
primary_measure: paired after-tax net prize difference per actual issue, averaged across all precommitted replicates
frequency_weights: counts in last 60 strictly prior draws plus 1; cold weights are reciprocals
schedule_basis: Inferred from latest official completed issue 26123 and Monday/Wednesday/Saturday rule; date is not a current-issue API confirmation. A schedule change requires recording an exception, never backdating.
promotions: exclude flagged promotional issues from conventional-return analysis, retain packet and exclusion reason; do not silently substitute another target
settlement: published actual per-ticket payouts; same-person same-game same-issue aggregation inside each alternative strategy/replicate; no cross-alternative aggregation; >10000 yuan taxed at 20%; no real purchases
missing_prizes: block settlement if any matched base/additional award is missing; never replace unknown by zero or estimated 80%
payout_counterfactual: price-taking scenario; published floating awards are not recomputed for hypothetical extra winners

stages.100_valid_issues: descriptive paired review; not an automatic efficacy claim

statistical_policy: No significance or profitability certification from 30/100 draws or 500 shared-history replicates. Any future formal decision rule/power design must be frozen in a new protocol before its holdout begins. Existing experiment remains descriptive prospective evidence.
integrity: exclusive-create packet/result files, source and code SHA256, replay check, append-only hash-chain ledger; local evidence only, no independent trusted timestamp certificate
